rec: Crush or ranged combat gear to fight the Golem guard
Ranged or melee combat gear for killing Arrav

st.t: Talk to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer to start the quest.
Enter the tomb south-west of Elias.
i: Crush or ranged combat gear to fight the Golem guard

st.t: Head south to the cave beyond the first room and search the southernmost skeleton for the first Mastaba key.
Go to the central room with the stone boat, east of the entrance. Search the skeleton north-west of the boat for the second Mastaba key.
Go to the south-east corner of the tomb. Search the odd markings to the south to get past the trap, searching again if you fail. Pull the lever, then search the odd markings next to you to get out.

Go to the north-east corner of the tomb, east of the imposing doors. Search the odd markings to the north to get past the trap, searching again if you fail. Pull the lever, then search the odd markings next to you to get out.
Open the imposing doors, ready to fight the Golem guard.
Fight the Golem guard. It is weak to crush style weapons. Use Protect from Melee to avoid damage from his attacks. When the screen shakes, step away from him to avoid taking damage.
Climb the stairs down the tomb basement.

Cross the coloured floor tiles by walking on either the blue and green tiles or the yellow and red tiles on the south side. Stepping on the wrong pair after you start does moderate damage. On the other side, pull the lever to disable the tiles.
Search the shelves to the west for an oil-filled canopic jar.
Go to the room to the south with the Tumeken statue and inspect the southern mural.
Put the Dwellberries in the Canopic jar.
Put the Ring of life in the Canopic jar.
Return to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer, north-east of the tomb's entrance. Walk out of the tomb, or hop worlds to land just outside it.

i: Crush or ranged combat gear to fight the Golem guard

st.t: Take the path just north-west of Trollheim towards the ice gate, and enter the cave directly west of the gate. You can use a Trollheim teleport tablet or the GWD Ghommal's Hilt teleport to get close.
Continue through the Trollheim cave, exiting at the Crevasse to the north-west. Use Protect from Melee to avoid taking damage from the Ice Trolls.
Enter the Trollweiss cave to the east.
Mine the rubble to clear a path to the end of the cave. Some piles can only be mined once from each side, so you may have to run around and mine the same rubble from another direction.
Climb up the stairs in the room with the red tile floor and talk to Arrav.
Talk to Arrav.
Enter the room to your east and search the tapestry for something to help you with your heist.
Search the tapestry in the south of the room.
Return to Elias south of Ruins of Uzer and ask him for help interpreting the plans.
Head to Zemouregal's base east of Varrock's sawmill and talk to Elias.
i: Ranged or melee combat gear for killing Arrav

st.t: Enter Zemouregal's base east of Varrock's sawmill.
i: Ranged or melee combat gear for killing Arrav

st.t: Make your way to the back of Zemouregal's base. Open the gate, the next gate, then the door, which uses your base key, and the gate into the kitchen, shown by the cooking range icon on the map. Wear your insulated boots and enter the sewers by the pipe on the south wall. Follow the path to its end and leave by the pipe there. Protect from Melee against the zombies to avoid most damage.
Enter the storage room to the south-east.
Search the western table for some decoder strips.
Open the chest for the code key.
Read the code key in your inventory and note its four letters.
Leave the storage room, go north to the metal doors and try to open them.

On the decoder strips, set strip 1 to the first letter, strip 2 to the second, strip 3 to the third and strip 4 to the fourth, and note the number each strip shows. Enter those four numbers using the up and down arrows, pressing the right arrow after each number.
Step through the metal doors.
Equip your crossbow and mith grapple, then grapple across the pipe above the fire traps.

Attempt to take Arrav's heart from the pedestal, ready for a fight with Arrav. Kill zombies as they appear (ranged weapons are handy here). Avoid the venom pools they spawn. Use Protect from Melee to avoid some of the incoming damage. When Arrav throws an axe towards you, step to the side or behind him.
i: Ranged or melee combat gear for killing Arrav

st.t: Fight Arrav. Kill zombies as they appear (ranged weapons are handy here). Avoid the venom pools they spawn. Use Protect from Melee to avoid some of the incoming damage. When Arrav throws an axe towards you, step to the side or behind him.
Elias teleports you back to the Uzer Oasis, south of the Ruins of Uzer. Talk to him there to finish the quest.

i: Ranged or melee combat gear for killing Arrav
